subject: Follow-up: evidence for 'who touched' dataset access (Entara)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Dawn Sullivan <d.sullivan@entarahealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T16:15:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call: who-touched evidence and export format needs

Hi Dawn — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and the items Entara asked us to follow up on: 

1) Evidence request: an extract showing "who accessed what and when" for model/feature calls that touch PHI/PII. You asked for a sample extract and schema so your audit team can validate ingest and retention.

2) Export formats & size: you indicated CSV or Parquet is preferred, compressed (gz/snappy). Target sample size ~50k-100k rows representing a typical 2-week slice across prod.

3) Fields you care about: timestamp (UTC), user identity (email or internal id), action (generate/read/delete), resource id (model/endpoint), request_id, prompt metadata (hash/pseudonym), response size, IP/geo, and any privacy classification tags.

4) Retention & residency: Entara asked for confirmation we can keep logs for 7 years and store the export in US-East only (no EU/APAC exports).

5) Pseudonymization: you flagged that raw prompts cannot be included in plain text; we should provide a pseudonymized prompt_hash and an explanation of re-identification controls (who can map hashes back to text and under what legal controls).

Next steps I propose:
- We produce a sanitized sample export (CSV + Parquet) and a short schema doc (attached stub: who-touched-minispec.txt).
- Confirm delivery channel (S3 presigned link vs secure ShareFile).
- Set a sync to review schema with your team if anything in the sample needs to change.

Can you confirm the deadline for the sample? We can have a preliminary extract ready within 48–72 hours if that works.

Thanks — Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: who-touched-minispec.txt (mini spec stub: lists draft columns and anonymization notes)

From: Dawn Sullivan <d.sullivan@entarahealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: security@entarahealth.com
Date: 2026-11-22T09:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: who-touched evidence and export format needs

Thanks Aditya — helpful recap. A few specifics from the Entara security & compliance side so your team can scope the extract precisely: 

- Required schema (we need these columns in the sample): timestamp_iso_utc, actor_identifier (email OR internal_id), actor_type (user/service), action_type (create/read/update/delete), resource_type (model, file, dataset), resource_id, model_version, request_id, prompt_hash, response_token_count, ip_address, geo_region, session_id, auth_method, encryption_key_id, retention_classification.

- Prompt text: Entara policy prohibits sharing raw prompt text in cleartext for PHI flows. A salted SHA256 prompt_hash is acceptable for correlation. If Redwood retains an internal mapping to the plaintext, we require a written explanation of access controls and that mapping cannot be shared without a legal process (we may request it under a scoped legal hold later).

- Export formats: CSV with header + UTF-8, and Parquet (schema-evolution friendly). Compression: gzip for CSV, snappy for Parquet. Row count: up to 100k rows is fine for initial review.

- Retention & residency: Entara requires a retention profile up to 7 years for audit logs related to PHI. Exports must be stored/transferred via US-East region only.

- Delivery: S3 presigned URL (12h expiry) is our preferred intake. For anything containing PII/PHI we require TLS and envelope encryption with a KMS key; please indicate the envelope KMS key id used.

- Additional control ask: include a column indicating whether the record contains any detected PII/PHI flags (true/false) and a small explanation column for redaction decisions.

Timeline: we need the sample and schema doc by EOD 2026-11-24 to slot the item into our audit queue.

I can share a short compliance checklist (PDF) — I attached a high-level requirements doc to this reply. Also: Entara requires an executed data processing addendum (DPA)/business associate agreement for PHI flows. Please have your legal point-of-contact send the draft or indicate next steps.

Dawn Sullivan
Head of Information Security, Entara Health
d.sullivan@entarahealth.com

Attachment: entara-log-schema-reqs.pdf

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Dawn Sullivan <d.sullivan@entarahealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T11:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: who-touched evidence and export format needs

Dawn — great, thanks for the clear spec. A few clarifications and commitments from our side: 

- Prompt hashing: we can provide a salted SHA256 prompt_hash in the export. We will not include raw prompt text in the sample delivery. We do retain an internal mapping for debugging but will only disclose that under a formal legal request; we will document who has access to the mapping (SecOps + Legal) and include that in the DPA.

- Formats: we will deliver both CSV (gzip) and Parquet (snappy) samples.

- PII/PHI flagging: our pipeline can include a boolean `pii_flag` column and an optional `redaction_reason` text field for rows we redact. Sample will include a few examples with redaction decisions explained.

- KMS & transfer: we can upload to an S3 bucket in us-east-1 and provide a presigned link with 12h expiry. We will include the envelope key id in the metadata and confirm TLS in transit.

- Retention: we can demonstrate a retention policy enforcement path and provide a retention snapshot for the requested 7-year classification — the extract itself will be a point-in-time export.

Proposed next steps:
- Redwood prepares sanitized sample export + schema doc and uploads to S3 by 2026-11-24 EOD.
- Schedule a 30-minute walkthrough with your security team to step through the schema and redaction logic. Are you available 2026-11-25 at 10:00 AM EST / 07:00 AM PST?

I will loop in our SE (Neha) to own the extraction plus Marissa for legal/DA coordination.

Thanks — we’ll get started on the sample today.

— Aditya
